notes.title: Patch Notes 7/17/2023
notes.content:
- Minor bug fixes.
- Fixed a soft lock that could occur for English language players on the 10th floor of the dungeon.
- Various text fixes.

notes.title: Etrian Odyssey II HD is Out Now!
notes.content:
Venture into the unknown in Etrian Odyssey II HD, now available for the first time on PC!  

[previewyoutube=RSeXc8JwwFw;full][/previewyoutube]

Purchase Etrian Odyssey II HD before 6/14 to receive in-game character portraits of Demi-fiend from Shin Megami Tensei III Nocturne and Teddie from Persona 4! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43618251/1b75919acf6eb08000891a71d25e53dc92f96f53.png[/img]

Build your own party from twelve different classes of heroes and climb through the Yggdrasil tree to reach the clouds and uncover the truth of High Lagaard.

Etrian Odyssey II HD Features: [list]

[*] Newly remastered graphics, remastered soundtrack and quality of life improvements, including difficulty selection and save slots
[*] Easy access to the Monstrous Codex, quest log and skill tree
[*] Maximize your adventuring by optimizing your party, and choose the character classes that work for your playstyle.

[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868170/Etrian_Odyssey_II_HD/]Etrian Odyssey II HD is now available on Steam![/url]
